premises.statement: The raw application table exposes is_integrated under that name, so no source-column override to integrated is needed.
premises.evidence_of_dependence: The displayed SQL uses "TRY_CAST(is_integrated AS BOOLEAN) AS is_integrated"; the generator patch adds overrides only for application_id and application_name before regenerating the SQL.
premises.alternative: The material index lists "integrated" in raw.application_history, not "is_integrated".
premises.reason: The remaining unmapped source column can still prevent the application staging model and its downstream models from executing.

fewer.reason: The visible change fixes two parts of the previously recorded mapping premise but leaves the third unresolved; no other new unsupported premise is established by this patch.
